desc:
Step into the ring with Prizefighter, Roblox's most authentic boxing game, featuring skill-based mechanics and satisfying counter-play.

Paid Early Access – You may encounter bugs or unfinished features, but your feedback directly shapes the future of Prizefighter.

Compete in fast-paced, action-packed matches and climb the leaderboard as you make your way up the ranks. Explore a detailed world full of activities and unique fighting venues. Sharpen your skills through an engaging training system, complete with challenging minigames. Feel the thrill of victory and the pressure of defeat.

Are you ready to claim victory? Lace up your gloves and find out.🥊
